LTTH Version 1.3.35 Release Notes

Version 1.3.35 releases WebGPU Fireworks 3.1.0 with controlled 3D depth and a Boykisser-led Furry Celebration.

- NEW: Furry Celebration stages all 15, 25, or 38 shells across far, mid, and near depth while other shows stay visually unchanged
- NEW: A procedural Boykisser/Silly Cat glyph appears in every cue and closes as one centered Hero cat
- IMPROVED: Rainbow and trans-color halos frame the choreography without obscuring its negative space
- IMPROVED: Renderer protocol 3 advertises depth3d-v1 and boykisser-v1 capabilities with actionable OBS refresh guidance
- IMPROVED: Older connected overlays retain a playable legacy burst fallback
- IMPROVED: WebGPU Fireworks plugin version advanced to 3.1.0
